rawPolicy: Exact connector-decoded string encoded as UTF-8, preserving original BOM and line endings. Original HTTP archive bytes are not provided by this connector.
timingLimit: Jobs-API step timestamps only. Subcommands sharing a step share its envelope; no subprocess start, end or duration is inferred.
exitBasis: The literal final node invocation, actual files/bytes output and immediate LASTEXITCODE guard establish this outcome. Jobs API success for the exact observed command step; no separate process timing is claimed.
executableBasis: Observed command name, not a resolved executable path.
cwdBasis: The exact checkout working-directory line in this job; reviewed selected script contains no directory change.
